originalTitle: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads

content: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. The law requires any ad — whether it’s a still image, video, audio, or text — that “has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence” to include a label in the same format as the ad itself. That applies to TV commercials from multi-billion-dollar companies, as well as restaurants’ ugly, crowded flyers about their wing specials. Pennsylvania is one of the first states to require disclosures on AI content. And it requires those labels regardless of where an ad was created. So you might see disclosures pop up in commercials in other states if they’re also expected to air in Pennsylvania. The law leaves many loopholes, though. For one, what constitutes “significantly modified” is subjective. There is also a carve-out for “parody, satire, commentary or criticism,” as well as anything that is “evidently fictional.” Again, what “evidently fictional” means is unclear. The wording also suggests only content that “uses synthetic content in a manner that creates a false consumer perception” about a product or service would require a disclosure. Again, leaving questions about what qualifies as “false” under the law and who makes those decisions. The office of State Senator Nick Pisciottano, who introduced the bill, did not immediately return a request for comment. [Media: https://youtu.be/zvfHKeqHFNw]
chineseTitle: 宾夕法尼亚州将要求在 AI 生成的广告上添加标签
chineseSummary: 周四，宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗 (Josh Shapiro) 将《人工智能欺骗性广告法案》签署为法律，要求披露人工智能生成的广告。该法律要求任何“经过人工智能重大修改或生成”的广告——无论是静态图像、视频、音频还是文本——都必须包含与[…]格式相同的标签。
chineseContent: 周四，宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗 (Josh Shapiro) 将《人工智能欺骗性广告法案》签署为法律，要求披露人工智能生成的广告。该法律要求任何“经过人工智能大幅修改或生成”的广告——无论是静态图像、视频、音频还是文本——都必须包含与广告本身格式相同的标签。这适用于价值数十亿美元的公司的电视广告，以及餐馆丑陋、拥挤的关于其翅膀特色菜的传单。宾夕法尼亚州是首批要求披露人工智能内容的州之一。无论广告是在哪里创建的，它都需要这些标签。因此，如果其他州的广告也预计在宾夕法尼亚州播出，您可能会看到披露信息。不过，该法律留下了许多漏洞。其一，“重大修改”的构成是主观的。 “戏仿、讽刺、评论或批评”以及任何“明显虚构”的内容也被排除在外。同样，“明显虚构”的含义尚不清楚。该措辞还表明，只有“以造成消费者错误认知的方式使用合成内容”的有关产品或服务的内容才需要披露。再次，留下关于法律规定什么是“错误”以及谁做出这些决定的问题。提出该法案的州参议员尼克·皮西奥塔诺(Nick Pisciottano)办公室没有立即回复置评请求。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/zvfHKeqHFNw]
